HARSH TERMS PRIVATE LIMITED
Date: 1st August 2026
Subject: Offer of Employment - Data Analyst

Dear Candidate,

01 POSITION
You are offered the role of Data Analyst reporting to the Head of Analytics.

02 SERVICE COMMITMENT
You shall serve the Company for a minimum period of three (3) years from the date of joining. In the event you resign before completing this period, you shall pay the Company a sum of Rs. 5,00,000 (Rupees Five Lakh only) as liquidated damages, recoverable as a debt.

03 NOTICE PERIOD
The Employee shall give ninety (90) days written notice of resignation. The Company may terminate this employment on thirty (30) days notice.

04 CONFIDENTIALITY
You shall keep confidential all information relating to the Company in perpetuity, whether or not such information is or becomes publicly available.

05 INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
All inventions, discoveries, improvements and works of authorship conceived or created by you during the term of your employment, whether during or outside the usual hours of work and whether on or off the premises of the Company, shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Company. You hereby irrevocably assign to the Company all right, title and interest therein, including all moral rights.

06 NON-COMPETITION
For a period of twenty-four (24) months following the termination of your employment for any reason whatsoever, you shall not directly or indirectly engage in, or be employed by, any business that competes with the Company anywhere in India.

07 TERMINATION
The Company may terminate your employment at any time with immediate effect for any act or omission which in the sole opinion of the Company is detrimental to the best interests of the Company.

08 GOVERNING LAW
Any dispute shall be referred to arbitration before a sole arbitrator appointed by the Company, seated in the city of the Company's registered office.
